data.title: 神裂火织 · 风力风车高桥上的唯闪破晓
data.description: 学园都市巨大风力发电机高架桥顶端，破晓第一抹晨曦切开云层。神裂火织瞬拔两米余长的“七天七刀”，超音速拔刀术撕裂长空，长马尾与单边撕裂牛仔裤在狂风中烈烈猎动。
data.location: wind-turbine suspension bridge high above Academy City skyline at breathtaking sunrise
data.action: dynamic mid-unsheathing slash of nodachi sword Shichiten Shichitou, hypersonic sonic blade aura cutting air, high ponytail flaring, piercing razor gaze
data.lighting: 破晓天际撕裂云层的烈日金芒与刀光白刃
data.promptProse: Saint Kaori Kanzaki executes an explosive draw of her nodachi Shichiten Shichitou atop a wind-turbine bridge, sunrise blazing along the razor edge.
data.animaCaption: Golden sunrise shatters the morning clouds as her two-meter nodachi flashes through the air.
